preserve_product_clause: The product itself remains completely still and unchanged in every frame: its exact shape, proportions, color, material, texture, logos and printed text stay identical, with no morphing, warping or distortion. Stable camera, photorealistic advertisement cinematography, consistent composition throughout.
note_cfg1_negative_prompt_vo_dung: Da kiem chung qua job test (negative_co_tac_dung: false khi cfg=1.0). Moi rang buoc 'giu nguyen san pham' PHAI nam trong chuyen_dong (positive), khong dua vao negative_prompt.
image_prompt_skeleton: Replace the entire {OLD_PRODUCT_SHORT} in the first image with the product from the second image, maintaining the second product's original size, proportions, and colors.
image_prompt_skeleton_note: Dung cho prompt accessory_flux_lab (anh tinh, khong lien quan video). {OLD_PRODUCT_SHORT} chi can 1-2 tu chung chung (vd 'bottle', 'shoe', 'phone', 'jar', 't-shirt', 'tube') de model biet xoa cai gi -- KHONG can mo ta chi tiet mau/chat lieu/vi tri cua vat cu, va KHONG can mo ta lai scene/anh sang/bo cuc (model tu giu nguyen phan khong duoc nhac toi). Xem note_prompt_phai_viet_tich_cuc de biet vi sao cau nay ngan nhu vay lai la ban DUNG.
note_base_frame_tim_qua_wipe: Nhieu video mau co hieu ung quet sang (light-wipe) o dau (~frame 15-25/129, 24fps), phai do tim khung SAU khi quet xong (bo cuc day du, khong con vet quet, chua co hieu ung mau phu them) de lam base.png -- KHONG mac dinh lay frame 0.
note_dan_lai_phai_tat: Van nen luon gui 'dan_lai': false khi goi /generate/accessory_flux_lab (tham so nay mac dinh BAT trong AccessoryFluxLab_Colab, thiet ke cho ca ghep phu kien NOI CHUOI -- chi lay vung thay doi tu anh model ve, ngoai vung giu NGUYEN pixel anh goc; voi use case THAY NGUYEN CA SAN PHAM cua minh thi dan_lai khong co ly do de BAT). NHUNG: da kiem chung thuc te (golden-fireworks, 2026-10) rang tat dan_lai KHONG tu no sua duoc loi 'giu nguyen hinh vat the cu' -- test voi dan_lai=false van ra y het hinh chai. Dung coi day la 'thuoc chua' chinh, chi la ve sinh tham so nen lam.
note_prompt_phai_viet_tich_cuc: LICH SU 2 LAN SUA (2026-10), DUNG CA HAI BAI HOC: (1) Model (Qwen3 text encoder, FLUX.2-klein 4B distilled) xu ly phu dinh kem -- cau mo dau kieu 'the {OLD_PRODUCT_DESC} is completely removed, including..., and nothing of its shape remains' (skeleton GOC) lai nhet ca khai niem vat CU vao embedding voi trong so cao (dau cau), lam nhieu template giu lai hinh vat cu. (2) Sua lan 1 bang cau 'tich cuc' (mo ta vi tri/ty le/huong san pham MOI, bo het phu dinh) -- CO CAI THIEN (vd dome-product: giay bien mat) nhung VAN THAT BAI tren ca kho nhat (golden-fireworks: 5/5 lan thu deu ra hinh chai). (3) NGUOI DUNG tu tay thu va XAC NHAN cong thuc that su hieu qua: cau LENH TRUC TIEP ngan gon 'Replace the entire X in the first image with the product from the second image, maintaining the second product's original size, proportions, and colors.' -- khong mo ta scene/anh sang/vi tri gi them, va day chinh la skeleton hien tai (xem image_prompt_skeleton). Ket luan: dieu quyet dinh la CO MOT CAU LENH THAY THE TRUC TIEP (dong tu 'Replace'), khong phai viec tranh/dung phu dinh nhu ket luan lan 1 tung nghi.
